sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS c FROM Artist
SELECT COUNT(*) AS c FROM Album
SELECT COUNT(*) AS c FROM Track WHERE UnitPrice > ?

description: TOP-5 最贵曲目（排序+限行）
sql: SELECT TrackId, Name, UnitPrice FROM Track ORDER BY UnitPrice DESC, TrackId ASC LIMIT 5

description: 曲目平均时长（单位换算+ROUND）
sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(Milliseconds) / 60000.0, 2) AS m FROM Track

description: 参数化过滤：某国客户数
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS c FROM Customer WHERE Country = ?
SELECT ROUND(MAX(Total), 2) AS m FROM Invoice
SELECT ROUND(SUM(Total), 2) AS s FROM Invoice

description: GROUP BY 按国家收入 TOP-5
sql: SELECT BillingCountry, ROUND(SUM(Total), 2) AS revenue FROM Invoice GROUP BY BillingCountry ORDER BY revenue DESC, BillingCountry ASC LIMIT 5

description: 列表：前10个流派（排序+限行）
sql: SELECT GenreId, Name FROM Genre ORDER BY Name ASC, GenreId ASC LIMIT 10
